item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return to St. Lucie County condos after two years
item.description: Residents of Villa Del Sol in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of displacement following structural damage that forced their evacuation.

item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 with late goals to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored twice in the final minutes Wednesday to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinal, with Enzo Fernandez equalizing in the 85th minute and Lautaro Martinez heading in the winner in stoppage time.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with England, Argentina, Spain and France advancing
item.description: England and Argentina advanced through quarterfinal victories over the weekend to complete the World Cup semifinal lineup alongside Spain and France, with all four highest-ranked teams reaching the final four.

item.title: Delray Beach dance studio hosts Bridgerton-themed masquerade gala July 24 for ninth anniversary
item.description: Fred Astaire Dance Studios Delray Beach is celebrating nine years with a Bridgerton-style masquerade gala featuring themed décor and ballroom dancing.

item.description: Republican U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly have emerged as frontrunners in Florida's gubernatorial primary race with the August 18 primary approaching. item.title: Security First Insurance cuts Florida homeowners rates by 5.6%, introduces disappearing deductible
item.description: The Ormond Beach-based insurer is the latest Florida company to reduce rates, citing fewer lawsuits from state reforms.

item.title: Palm City weather spotter with Navy meteorology background discusses forecasting technology evolution
item.description: Brian Botley, a Palm City resident and WPTV Weather Spotter, shared how his Navy training in meteorology led to a lifelong passion for tracking weather in the Treasure Coast.
